title: Step runner: Item stream, per-site FIFO queue, dispatcher, coalescing window
description:
Fire steps when a checklist step becomes ready, including console board moves. Stream on the Item table, one FIFO group per Story, idempotent run claims per Story version, window shorter after a person acts. No whole-table reads (today every delivery reads the Automation table).

**Always-on agent standard (2026-11-16; design `docs/design/always-on-agents-architecture.md`)**
This story is slice B2 of the standard: **the Item change feed and dispatcher**. It serves every agent that listens to Item changes, not only Story steps.

- The feed turns each Item change (a Story version created, a stage changed, a checklist sub-task changed), from any writer including the console board, into wakes on the site's wake queue (PPY-567bf9), one per listening agent, read from the site's cached agent definitions (PPY-68abaa) by index.
- The wake key is `<agent>|<lineage>|<version>|<what>`; the run record made from it is the claim (PPY-70c6e8). No claim rows in the monitoring table and no router publication are needed.
- One Story at a time comes from the queue's message group (PPY-a200ec); the quiet window for paid steps is PPY-67e3cd; the loop guard is PPY-4e7e8b.
- An agent's own version does not wake that agent for the same step.

**Acceptance criteria (added)**
- A console board move, a CLI write and an agent's own write each wake the listening agents once.
- No code lists the `Automation` table per change.
- Gherkin: item-change-feed.feature (a console move wakes the stage's agent; a new version wakes each listening step once; a redelivered stream record starts nothing twice; an agent's own version does not re-wake it; a change nobody listens for sends nothing).
- Infrastructure: stream on the Item table and the feed function live in the deferred `agents` stack (PPY-e06835).

comments.text:
Built on branch feat/PPY-8a374e-item-change-feed, PR 1686 (to develop, not merged). Item stream (both images) switched on with the agents stack; feed function (4 resources) in amplify/agents/item-change-feed.ts; logic in src/papyrus_content/item_change_feed.py; listener index (agent_listeners.py, site document kind listeners) written by the new deploy step papyrus agents listeners (build spec runs it after agents schedules). Specs: features_backend/item-change-feed.feature (18 scenarios), pytest, agent-sync infra test.

Left for PPY-67e3cd (coalescing window): the wake's trigger carries paid, serialBy, actorKind (agent or person), actorLabel and at; the window sits between the feed and send_wake and keys on agent+lineage+step without the version. Left for PPY-4e7e8b (loop guard): same fields; count agent changes per Story since the last actorKind person. Neither is built.

Left for PPY-4af216 (B6): story_triggers.stage_automations still lists the Automation table per stage delivery (CLI path); monitoring_router gate lists it per sweep. Not removed here because the Stage Bots have no replacement until B6 moves them onto the feed.

Live proof that needs a deploy (not done): (1) second deploy of a site adds the Item stream and the feed; (2) papyrus agents listeners writes listener index version 1; (3) a console board move and a CLI save each put one wake per listening agent on the queue; (4) the same stream record again puts none inside five minutes and starts no second run after; (5) dead-letter queue stays empty; (6) feed lag alarm is PPY-45ef76.
